opinions.text: C. A. 2d Cir. [Certiorari granted, 459 U. S. 1199.] Motion of Arthur Andersen & Co. et al. for leave to participate in oral argument as amici curiae, for divided argument, and for additional time for oral argument denied. Motion of respondents for divided argument granted.
